blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The Roman Catholic Diocese of Calapan, through its Diocesan Social Action Center (DSAC) and parish communities in Puerto Galera and San Teodoro, formally opposed a proposed 10,265.3-hectare (ha) mineral reservation. It cited potential threats to forests, watersheds, biodiversity, and the ancestral lands of Indigenous communities. In a joint position paper Tuesday, the church groups expressed concern over the proposed declaration of portions of Puerto Galera and San Teodoro as a Mineral Reservation Area, saying it could have far-reaching ecological, environmental, economic, legal, social, and cultural implications.
